svg.title: Byte Saves The Day — project card
svg.desc: A hardcover storybook with real thickness: Byte's Energy Hunt and Right & Left open inside its pages, then turn the page themselves when you finish. Built with Css 3D, Javascript, Web Audio. Live demo. Banner: the book's real cover.
